ai.title: AI usage
ai.range: {{from}} to {{to}}. Counts only, with no sentences and no transaction amounts.
ai.transactionsHint: The main bar is a share of all drafts created. The branch under a step is what left it.
ai.funnelExisting: AI transactions still in the table

usage.hint: Transaction counts use the transaction date. Messages use the time they were sent.

ai.messagesHint: Each send to the drawer is counted. Conversations are not a separate count.

tips.originAi: A transaction saved after the user approved a draft. This is not the message count.
tips.originAuto: A transaction saved without an approve click.
tips.funnelOpen: A draft in ready, needs_review, or approved. Not saved and not rejected.
tips.funnelSaved: Every draft that was saved once, including ones undone later.
tips.funnelExisting: This can be lower than drafts still saved, if the user deleted transactions later.
tips.committed: A draft whose status is saved. Undoing it is counted separately and does not remove this row.
tips.rejected: A draft the user rejected before a transaction was saved.
tips.reverted: A transaction that was saved and then undone.
tips.messagesTotal: Text, images, PDFs, and audio added together. A whole conversation is not one unit.
tips.inputText: A text message in the drawer.
tips.inputImage: An image. PDFs are counted on their own.
tips.inputPdf: A PDF file, usually a receipt.
tips.questions: A question about the data, such as how much was spent. Not a save message.
tips.receipts: A saved transaction linked to its receipt file.
tips.rules: An active rule the user approved. Not limited to this date range.
tips.drafts: Drafts opened for the user, including ones that were not saved.
tips.app: Cost of calls from the app, after the source:app tag started.
tips.eval: Cost of measurement runs, tagged source:eval.

ai.spendMixed: This range includes days before calls were tagged, so app use and measurement runs are still mixed.

posthog.title: Product analytics (PostHog)
posthog.subtitle: Live aggregates from PostHog EU — no raw financial data
posthog.unavailable: PostHog is unavailable. Ensure Edge Function secrets are configured.
posthog.usersCompareNote: PostHog counts web product-event actives. The Users tab active_30d counts DB users with a transaction — different definitions.

tooltips.dau7d: Unique persons who sent at least one event in the last 7 days (not classic daily DAU).
tooltips.wau30d: Unique persons who sent at least one event in the last 30 days (MAU-style; not classic 7-day WAU).
tooltips.pageviews7d: How many $pageview events were recorded in the last 7 days.
tooltips.importSuccess: Share of imports that completed successfully out of imports started in the last 7 days.
tooltips.importStarted: How many transaction_import_started events in the last 7 days.
tooltips.importCompleted: How many transaction_import_completed events in the last 7 days.
tooltips.signups7d: How many signup_completed events in the last 7 days.
tooltips.transactions7d: How many transaction_created events in the last 7 days.
tooltips.exceptions7d: How many JavaScript exceptions were auto-captured in the last 7 days.
tooltips.surveys30d: How many survey sent events in the last 30 days (submitted feedback).
tooltips.topPaths: Which page paths were viewed most in the last 7 days.
tooltips.eventCounts: How often each product event fired in the last 7 days.

users.title: User Statistics
users.activeNote: Active = users who created a transaction in the last 30 days. Not the same as PostHog (web product events only).

tooltips.total: Accounts in auth.users that are not deleted.
tooltips.active30d: Distinct users who created at least one transaction in the last 30 days (by created_at). Not last_sign_in — and different from PostHog (web product events only).
tooltips.new30d: Users who signed up in the last 30 days.
tooltips.new7d: Users who signed up in the last 7 days.

finance.title: Financial Statistics
finance.disclaimer: Checkboxes filter which currencies enter the totals. There is no FX conversion. When more than one currency is selected, amounts have no currency sign.

tooltips.totalIncome: Sum of income-type transactions only (excludes exempt income).
tooltips.totalExpenses: Sum of expense-type transactions only (excludes recognized expenses).
tooltips.totalDonations: Sum of donation-type transactions only (excludes non-tithe donations).

downloads.title: Desktop Download Requests (Email)
downloads.note: Counts are based on successful email replies (status=sent). Currently all requests are for Windows.

tooltips.avgTransactions: Average transaction count per user who has at least one transaction (all time).
tooltips.usersWithTransactions: Distinct users with at least one transaction (all time).

trends.title: Trends Over Time
trends.financialDisclaimer: Checkboxes filter which currencies enter each series. No FX conversion. Mixed selection has no currency sign.
trends.downloadRequestsHint: Same metric as the Downloads tab (status=sent). GitHub release totals stay on that tab.
trends.activeUsersHint: Active users count distinct users by transaction date (including backdated imports), not by created_at.

monitoring.title: System Monitoring
monitoring.edgeFunctionsDisclaimer: Edge Function metrics here are mainly download-email scoped, not all functions.

tooltips.database: Database status - checks connections, slow queries, and tables without RLS
tooltips.auth: Authentication system status - checks signups, password resets, and recent events
tooltips.edgeFunctions: Metrics mainly for the download-email Edge Function (not all Edge Functions)
tooltips.email: Email sending status - bounce rate and alerts
tooltips.activeConnections: Number of active connections to the database. High values may indicate an issue
tooltips.slowQueries: Queries taking more than 1 second on average. Consider optimization or adding indexes
tooltips.seqScans: Sequential Scans - full table scans. High values indicate missing indexes
tooltips.indexScans: Index Scans - scans using indexes. Higher values relative to Seq Scans are better
tooltips.deadTuples: Rows deleted/updated but not cleaned up. High values require VACUUM
tooltips.rowCount: Number of rows in the table
tooltips.signups: Number of new signups in the last 24 hours
tooltips.passwordResets: Number of password reset requests in the last 24 hours
tooltips.invocations: Number of Edge Function invocations in the last 24 hours
tooltips.errors: Number of errors in Edge Functions in the last 24 hours
tooltips.errorRate: Percentage of errors out of all invocations. Above 5% requires investigation
tooltips.securityAdvisory: Security alerts - tables without RLS, unusual permissions, etc.
tooltips.performanceAdvisory: Performance alerts - missing indexes, slow queries, etc.
tooltips.emailSends: Number of emails sent in the last 24 hours
tooltips.emailDeliveries: Number of emails delivered in the last 24 hours
tooltips.emailBounces: Emails that bounced - invalid address or full mailbox
tooltips.emailComplaints: Users who marked the email as spam - important to address!
tooltips.emailDeliveryRate: Percentage of emails delivered out of total sent
tooltips.emailBounceRate: Percentage of bounced emails. Above 5% requires attention
tooltips.cloudflare: Cloudflare Workers status - requests, errors, and performance
tooltips.cfRequests: Number of requests to Cloudflare Workers in the last 24 hours
tooltips.cfErrors: Number of errors in Cloudflare Workers in the last 24 hours
tooltips.cfErrorRate: Percentage of errors out of all requests
tooltips.vercel: Vercel Deployments status - recent deployments and status
tooltips.vercelDeployments: List of recent deployments on Vercel

monitoring.addAwsKeys: Add AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY to Supabase Secrets
